scenes.setting: A paper double left reading on the toilet while Klein divines above the fog (visions only: a brown-haired, brown-eyed stranger by a rose-filled glass greenhouse, two suitcases of notes and gold, and a full human skin he pulls on to become 'Jason'): the portrait everyone is hunting is a decade-old mask
scenes.text_anchor: It was a slightly pale piece of human skin!

scenes.setting: A coin says stay home, and Stanton arrives: two detectives' families died today — one of fright, one of excitement — pulling the Mandated Punishers and every High-Sequence Beyonder onto the case, which is exactly what Jason wants; his real target is someone else entirely
Quelaag Club lobby: Dr. Aaron, busy and about to be a father again — his wife pregnant 'more than a month' — a number that stops Klein and makes him look into the doctor's eyes
